title: fxv interrupted-sync error detail
description: Describes a sync/goto/revert/resolve that was interrupted before it finished, leaving the workspace in an inconsistent state. Only ever a detail payload, riding in an error envelope's `error_data` (with `kind` of `interrupted-sync`, alongside exit code 98) when a command refuses to run because of it. `fxv resume` recovers rather than reports, so asking what state a workspace is in is `fxv status`'s job.

oneOf.description: The journal was readable, so the run can be finished with `fxv resume --continue` or undone with `fxv resume --rollback`.

summary.description: A ready-to-display sentence describing what the run was doing, phrased per operation, e.g. "Was syncing from main.11 to main.12."

target_revision.description: Revision spec the interrupted run was moving to, and where a continue finishes.

source_revision.description: Revision spec the workspace is still recorded as synced to, and where a rollback returns to. Absent when the interrupted run was a checkout into a workspace that had never synced.

total_entries.description: File changes in the interrupted run's plan.

preserved_entries.description: Entries whose locally-modified file was moved aside rather than overwritten.

remaining_entries.description: Entries that never reached a terminal state, and which a continue re-drives.

sampled_unfinished_paths.description: A capped sample of the unfinished paths; `remaining_entries` is the true count.

oneOf.description: The journal survived but could not be parsed, so neither recovery operation can act on it.
